C0525.title: Fujian Electromechanical Company Inspection Reveals Inflated Transport Costs for Civil Explosive Products
C0525.summary: In August 2022, the Fujian Provincial Party Committee inspection team fed back inspection findings to Fujian Electromechanical (Holding) Co., Ltd. The later rectification notice stated that Haixia Chemical and its branches were checked for problems including irregular bidding in civil explosive product transport, significantly inflated transport costs, and suspected benefit transfer. The company formed a verification team and revised procurement and bidding controls.
